description: Ethiopian cooking centers on berbere, injera, and niter kibbeh. Bold spice blends, slow stews, and starch scoops — communal eating is central.

attributes.micro_lesson: Bloom berbere or ras el hanout in oil; long simmer with legumes; acid from lime or tamarind at finish.
attributes.shopping_tip: Spice blends, palm or peanut oil, and injera or rice as base.
flavor_building: Start with niter kibbeh as your cooking medium.
Season with berbere — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around injera as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Ethiopian food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
